prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Pearland, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1161; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision at the intersection in Pearland, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.

A: Sorry, I'd rather just keep my name off the recording. You can refer to me as the claimant.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe the vehicle you were driving at the time of the collision?

A: It was my sedan, a silver four-door. I was heading east on the main road and had the green light.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not really. It came through from the cross street on my right side. I heard the horn and then it hit my driver's door.

Q: How fast were you traveling when you entered the intersection?

A: Around the posted limit, maybe a little under. I wasn't rushing. I'd been stopped at that light a few cycles before.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was. The airbag deployed, though, and I got thrown against the door and the steering wheel.

Q: Where did you first feel injury?

A: My left wrist. I put my hand out to brace and it bent backward badly. The emergency room later confirmed a fracture. They put me in a splint and I've had follow-up visits since.

Q: Have you received any treatment beyond the emergency room?

A: Yes, I've seen an orthopedic specialist twice. I'm still doing physical therapy a few times a week, and I can't grip things well yet.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add about the collision?

A: Only that I was driving carefully and the other driver came into my lane of travel. That's really all I know.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
